title: Fine Arts Concert Attire Schedule, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees: Attire Rates for Band and Choir
content:
**Fine Arts concert attire schedule — scheduled attire rate.** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, the scheduled attire rate of the concert attire package under **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** is 40.00 for band when the student's district enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year shows grade 06 or above, 30.00 for choir when that record shows grade 06 or above, and otherwise the Fine Arts Performing Ensemble uniform package of the activity fee catalogue (0.00). The enrollment record is the one Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions keeps.

| Ensemble | Grade on the enrollment record in status enrolled | Scheduled attire rate |
|---|---|---|
| band | 06 through 12 | 40.00 |
| choir | 06 through 12 | 30.00 |
| orchestra or theatre | any | catalogue uniform package, 0.00 |
| band or choir | no enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year | catalogue uniform package, 0.00 |
